I built Skylark Lake in Unreal Engine with my dot in ChatGPT using Fable 5.2 to plan and Opus 5.5 to build.

I can click to pull them towards my cursor and right click to scatter them. 

First off I love working with my dot. Secondly, we tried using 6.1 Sol but I probably should have used Astra to plan and Sol to build, the result wasn’t great but I’m not blaming the model. Could have been a context prompting issue on my part. Our second run at it was with Fable + Opus and my dot provided more context from me that time so who knows Astra + Sol could have done this too for all I know. We were just moving fast and I was looking for something big to throw at Fable 5.2 since it just dropped. 

I also tried making this a web game (apparently you can make web games with Unreal Engine now) but it’s a GPU hog so it was a no go.
